def bresenham_line(r1, c1, r2, c2):
    """Draw line from (r1,c1) to (r2,c2)"""
    result = []
    dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else (-1 if r2 < r1 else 0)
    dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else (-1 if c2 < c1 else 0)
    dy = abs(r2 - r1)
    dx = abs(c2 - c1)
    
    err = dy - dx
    
    while True:
        result.append((r1, c1))
        if r1 == r2 and c1 == c2:
            break
        
        e2 = 2 * err
        if e2 > -dy:
            err -= dy
            r1 += dr
        if e2 < dx:
            err += dx
            c1 += dc

def bresenham_line(r1, c1, r2, c2, val=5):
    """Draw filled line segment"""
    result = []
    dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else (-1 if r2 < r1 else 0)
    dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else (-1 if c2 < c1 else 0)
    dy = abs(r2 - r1)
    dx = abs(c2 - c1)
    
    err = dy - dx
    
    while True:
        result.append((r1, c1))
        if r1 == r2 and c1 == c2:
            break
        
        e2 = 2 * err
        if e2 > -dy:
            err -= dy
            r1 += dr
        if e2 < dx:
            err += dx
            c1 += dc
    
    return result
